name: What tools and materials are needed for cracked tile replacement?

mainEntity.name: What tools and materials are needed for cracked tile replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For cracked tile replacement, essential tools and materials include a hammer, chisel or oscillating multi-tool for removal, a grout saw or knife, a utility knife, thin-set mortar, a notched trowel, grout, a grout float, sponges, and buckets. Safety glasses and gloves are also crucial. You'll also need the replacement tile itself, which ideally should match the existing flooring in size, color, and finish. For precise cuts, a tile cutter or wet saw may be necessary, especially for tiles with irregular shapes or those located at edges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tools include a hammer, chisel, grout saw, thin-set mortar, and grout. You'll also need the matching replacement tile and safety gear.
